item.title: Apprenticeship Training
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 15,400 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-11T12:00:00Z
Sunderland City Council ("the Contracting Authority", "the Authority" and/ or "the Council") is seeking to appoint training providers ("Suppliers") to deliver Apprenticeship Training. Tender documents can be accessed www.open-uk.org The Framework will be divided into 52 Lots, reflecting the Council's principal service areas. Each Lot will comprise of apprenticeship standards relevant to the Council. Bidders may submit tenders for one, some or all Lots that you are able to deliver standards under, for example under Lot 2 - Business and Administration there are multiple standards included, bidders are not required to deliver all standards under each lot. This procurement involves the establishment of alight touch framework under Section 45 of the Procurement Act 2023 ("the Act") using the flexibilities permitted under the Act in respect to light touch contracts (defined under Section 9 of the Act). Please note a supplier briefing session will be held via Microsoft Teams at 1pm Friday 27th November 2026. If you would like to attend please request an invite via the correspondence section in OPEN detailing email addresses of who would like to attend.
